# Highline Warren

Highline Warren is a Repair and Maintenance company. Highline Warren employs 927 people (+12.1% YoY, +100 people) and has an annual revenue of $458M, founded in 2020. Headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee, United States, with offices including Elkton, Greensboro, Grand Prairie, Albertville, and Leominster. Its workforce is distributed across United States, China, Mexico, and Thailand.

## About

Highline Warren is a vertically integrated distributor of maintenance consumables with unmatched access to the North American market. Headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee, the company operates 23 distribution and manufacturing facilities across North America, offering more than 30,000 products to over 10,000 customers.

Highline Warren provides access to over 400 trusted brands — including national, owned, and private label products — and serves as a strategic manufacturing partner to top retailers across North America. With industry-leading fill rates and a strategic network that reaches 95% of the U.S. population within two days, the company simplifies the supply chain for its customers. Employing more than 1,700 teammates, Highline Warren is driven by people powered performance. For more information, visit our website at www.HighlineWarren.com.

Highline Warren takes the safety of candidates and teammates seriously. In light of recent employment scams, we’d like to reinforce that we will never ask for personal data or banking information, nor will we request an applicant to purchase equipment during the interview process. All recruiting communications will come via @highlinewarren.com or @clearcompany.com email addresses. If you receive an email from another domain requesting personal or financial information, please confirm with recruiting@highlinewarren.com before sharing any information.
